recovered_history.summary: Removed prototype-only dialogue provenance chrome while preserving Living NPC and Social World behavior through follow-up regression tests.
Kept distinct meaningful Living World events visible by de-duplicating public labels before applying the visible event cap.
Presented quest outcomes as player-facing quest status instead of generic system chrome.
Guided the player toward waiting after quest completion so the Living World demonstration is discoverable without test-only sequence knowledge.

Added one-click Markdown export of the current playtest session report from normal game mode using the existing canonical server report.
Added a Windows double-click human-playtest launcher that resets the isolated demo database, waits for the local server, and opens normal player mode with report export available.

Used the first real human FAIL report to fix text-entry key capture, repeated/missed E interactions, Oren auto-submit, ghost NPC talk controls, visible NPC materialization, canonical visual re-anchoring, and misleading untested-reload report semantics. All six mandatory gates passed on the stabilized head.
